'''Mr. Bonteri''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], who was married to [[Mina Bonteri/Legends|Mina Bonteri]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Together they had a son, [[Lux Bonteri/Legends|Lux Bonteri]]. When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] began, the Bonteri family joined countless beings who sided with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], and Bonteri's wife in fact greatly respected the Separatist leader, [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]].

Bonteri was sent to the planet [[Aargonar/Legends|Aargonar]] to set up a base for the Confederacy. Soon, however, [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] [[Battle on Aargonar|attacked his base]], and he was forced to fight back in self defense. He was killed by the Republic forces, and his [[Death/Legends|death]] only further resolved his family's belief in the good of the Confederacy.<ref name="HOBS">{{TCW|Heroes on Both Sides}}</ref>
